author: Linnaeus, 1758

months.note: 국내에서는 오래전에 관찰된 기록만 있고, 번식지에서는 5월 중순~7월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 국내에서는 오래전 경기도와 강화도에서 관찰된 기록만 있는 미조이다. 번식지에서는 초지와 습지, 강가 등지의 땅 위에 풀을 쌓아 올리거나 맨땅·암석지에 작은 돌을 모아 둥지를 만들고, 한배에 알을 2개 낳는다. 습지에 내려 두 다리를 번갈아 옮기며 조용히 걸어 다니면서 먹이를 찾고, 메뚜기류와 딱정벌레류 곤충, 복족류 연체동물, 환형동물, 곡식과 그 밖의 식물을 먹는다. 국외에서는 아프리카 북부, 유럽 동남부, 몽골, 이라크, 이란, 인도, 중국 동북부, 일본 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Demoiselle Crane (Grus virgo), adult: forehead slate-black mixed with grey; crown and nape pale ash-grey; lores, face, throat and the whole neck black, the black reaching the eye and continuing as a band above it; long white plumes springing from behind the eye and trailing back as a tuft towards the nape; long black plumes on the lower foreneck hanging over the breast; body and wing coverts blue-grey; long, pointed grey tertials drooping over the tail; primaries blackish. Bill short, olive with a reddish-orange tip; iris red; legs and feet black.
art.pose: walking slowly through a wetland, stepping alternately and searching the ground for food
art.scene: Korean grassy wetland beside a river, open meadow and shallow marsh; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking: blue-grey body, black face and neck with long black breast plumes hanging over the chest, white ear-tuft from behind the eye to the nape, pale grey crown, short olive bill tipped reddish-orange, long black legs

adult, head detail, side view: slate-black forehead flecked grey, pale ash-grey crown and nape, black lores joining the black band above the eye, red eye, white plume tuft behind the eye, short olive bill with a reddish-orange tip
art.build: Smallest crane, about 98cm, slimmer and more delicate than a Common Crane, about the size of a Grey Heron. Small rounded head on a long slender neck. Bill short, shorter than the head, straight and slender. Legs long and black, with bare tibia. At rest the long pointed tertials hang over the tail, less bushy than in other cranes. In flight neck and legs outstretched, grey wings with dark flight feathers, the black foreneck visible from below.
avoid: Do not paint a red crown patch or a white stripe down the neck — those are Common Crane (Grus grus); this species has a white ear-tuft and black breast plumes.
Do not paint a long dagger-like bill; the bill is short.
Do not paint a bushy, curled tertial bustle; the tertials are long, straight and pointed.
Do not paint grey or pink legs; they are black.
